app.title: KnowledgeBase Console
app.tagline: Read the knowledge base. Operate the librarian.

common.reasonHelp: At least 10 characters. It is recorded in the audit trail.
common.opensExternal: opens an external site in a new tab

nudges.label: Suggestions for you
nudges.resume: Pick up where you left off
nudges.resumeBody: You opened “{{title}}” a while ago and have not been back since.
nudges.quizBody: You have read this page more than once. A short quiz shows what stuck.
nudges.sectionBody: There are pages in this section you have not read.
nudges.welcomeBody: The first section is the best place to begin.
nudges.settingsHelp: Small hints such as “pick up where you left off”, worked out in your browser from your own reading progress. Nothing extra is sent to the server; dismissed hints are remembered in this browser only.

mode.dryHelp: Mutating tools are denied; the librarian only proposes.
mode.liveHelp: Changes are written and logged. Every action can be rolled back.

home.title: Start here
home.subtitle: Everything a new joiner reads, watches and follows to build AI on the paved roads.
home.noStale: Every page is within its review window.
home.sectionsSub: Every page has an owner and a review window.
home.bandBody: Run the librarian in dry-run mode to see what it would fix. Nothing changes until an operator applies it.

browse.title: Browse
browse.noPages: No pages in this section yet.

page.withheldHelp: The last audit found sensitive content on this page. The owner has been asked to clean it up; the body is not shown until then.
page.reportMessage: Tell the owner what you found
page.reportSent: Thanks. The owner ({{owner}}) has been notified.
page.noFindings: No open findings for this page.
page.reportMessageHelp: At least 10 and at most {{max}} characters.
page.notYetTranslated: Not yet translated into this language; showing English.

run.title: Run an audit
run.budgetHelp: At most {{max}} on this server; enforced between turns, so a single turn can overshoot.
run.network: Verify external links over the network
run.liveLocked: Live runs are disabled on this server (KB_ALLOW_LIVE).
run.liveConfirm: You are about to let the librarian change pages.
run.forcedDry: Live was requested but the server forced a dry run.
run.operatorOnly: Only operators can start audits. Add your key in Settings.
run.atlassianLocked: Atlassian is not configured on this server

audit.cancelPrompt: Stop this audit? Work done so far is kept in the report.

rollback.title: Roll back an action
rollback.help: The page is restored to its state before the action. Refused if the page changed since, unless forced.
rollback.forceHelp: Only when you have checked what changed after the action.
rollback.dryRunAction: This action was only proposed in a dry run; there is nothing to roll back.
rollback.alreadyRolledBack: This action has already been rolled back.
rollback.editsNow: This edits the knowledge base now.

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyHelp: Stored in this browser only. Needed to start, cancel or roll back audits.
settings.liveAllowed: Live audits allowed on this server

chat.title: Ask the librarian
chat.emptyHint: Ask anything about this knowledge base, by typing or by voice.

quiz.toolbarLabel: Ask the librarian about the selected text
quiz.requestElaborate: Tell me more about this: background, related pages and pitfalls.
quiz.explainMistakesPrompt: Explain why the right answers to these questions are right:
quiz.missedLine: {{n}}. {{question}} — I chose “{{chosen}}”; the right answer is “{{answer}}”.

auth.ssoHelp: Sign in with your organisation account to save your progress and personalise the knowledge base.
auth.ssoUnavailable: Single sign-on is not configured on this server.
auth.signOutEverywhereHelp: Ends your sessions in every browser and on every device; sign in again to continue.

profile.yourDataHelp: Signed in, the knowledge base remembers which pages you read, your persona and your quiz results — nothing else. You can delete it at any time.

persona.title: Persona
persona.chooseHelp: Pick the role closest to yours and the knowledge base puts the pages written for it first. Every page stays available to you.
persona.forYouEmpty: No pages are written for this persona yet.

insights.intro: Which pages confuse people: problem reports, reading, quiz results and unanswered questions, as counts only.
insights.empty: No insights yet — refresh to compute them
insights.kNote: Reader-derived numbers are hidden for pages with fewer than {{k}} readers (hidden pages: {{suppressed}}).
insights.none: Nothing to show for this window.
